description: This Java class defines a custom JSP tag 'ProductDescriptionUrlTag' that generates URLs for product descriptions in an e-commerce storefront. It constructs URLs based on the product description, store configurations, and request context.

classes.name: ProductDescriptionUrlTag
classes.description: A custom JSP tag class that constructs and outputs product description URLs based on request context, store configuration, and product details.

methods.name: doStartTag
methods.description: Generates the product URL and writes it to the page output. Constructs URL based on scheme, domain, context path, and product-specific URL or ID segment.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Handles tag closure, returns constant indicating page evaluation.
